title: Output spec (ARCHITECTURE §3.2). null = unconstrained; the checker verifies only set fields.

rotation.description: CONVENTION (single, everywhere): CLOCKWISE degrees. In a spec: the net rotation of the picture a viewer sees, relative to the input's displayed picture, however achieved (display-matrix metadata or re-encoded pixels); 90 = turn right/clockwise, 270 = turn left/counterclockwise, 180 = upside down. The checker measures it from picture content. In a probe result: the clockwise degrees the container's display matrix tells players to apply (ffprobe reports the same angle counterclockwise, so it is negated).

quality.description: Minimum picture quality of the output vs the input (checker v1.1). null = unconstrained. Size-target outputs get a default floor from training/config.py even when this is null.

interval_s.description: One frame at t = k * interval_s for k = 0, 1, 2, ... while t < duration - half a source frame.

expected_count.description: Exact number of images (matched with zero tolerance). With only interval_s set, the checker accepts the strict count, or one fewer when the last sample lies within half an interval of the end (FFmpeg's fps filter drops that final slot; select keeps it). Rule and evidence: training/config.py.
